name: zeffect_anim_set_zbd_filename
description: zEffect_Anim::SetZbdFilename copies a valid animation ZBD filename into the global animation archive path and rejects overlong names.
known_limits: No isolated VC COFF byte comparison is recorded; tier S verification is deferred to the coherent zEffect animation source-cluster pass.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly for 0x45e210 validates computing filename length, reporting through zError::ReportOldNoOp and returning without copying when the length is greater than 128 bytes.
Binary Ninja assembly validates copying the filename including its terminator into g_zEffectAnim_ZbdFilename when the length is accepted.
The native smoke verifies normal filename replacement and that an overlong filename leaves the previous global path unchanged.
